'''Kritz Drassarb''' was an individual who served as a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the later [[Time/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Drassarb studied under the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vhiin Thorla]] and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], while the pair was investigating a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] operating in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==Biography==
Kritz Drassarb was born during the waning [[Time/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and joined the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. After becoming a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], Drassarb [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] under the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vhiin Thorla]]. In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], Drassarb and Thorla were sent by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to investigate a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that were operating in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They came into conflict with the pirates and two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, the pirate band had been dismantled and Drassarb was [[Death/Legends|dead]].<ref name="TS" />

The Jedi Council absolved Thorla of any responsibility for causing Drassarb's death, though the Twi'lek still blamed himself for it. He returned to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], where he meditated on how he could have saved Drassarb. Thorla soon found a new purpose and began rescuing Twi'leks that had been captured by en[[Slavery/Legends|slavers]]. He established a [[The Enclave|settlement]] on Ryloth to serve as a safe haven for individuals liberated from slavery and was very protective of the settlement's inhabitants because he still felt guilt for Drassarb's death.<ref name="TS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Drassarb was first mentioned by [[Lee Pickler]] in ''[[Twi'light Storm]]'', an adventure in the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign, which was a supplement to the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. However, ''Twi'light Storm'' only referred to the individual as "Thorla's Padawan"<ref name="TS" /> and the character was not assigned the name Kritz Drassarb until the Padawan was mentioned in the role-playing supplement ''[[Echoes of the Jedi]]'', in [[2008]].<ref name="EOTJ">{{DoD|Echoes of the Jedi}}</ref> Neither source revealed Drassarb's [[Species/Legends|species]] or [[Gender/Legends|gender]].

In ''Twi'light Storm'', it is possible for Jedi Master [[Devan For'deschel]] to tell the player characters about Drassarb's death, if they choose to ask her about why Thorla is on Ryloth.<ref name="TS" />
